semantic_changes: V3 is an authored semantic revision of router v2, not byte-equivalent to the original skill or a proven content-preserving compiler transformation.
Discovery frontmatter and both example references remain byte-for-byte unchanged; only those example references retain complete verbatim-source mappings.

Action checkpoints require completed user-visible pre/post automatic announcements and usable optional offers as actual Markdown prose, not fenced or quoted examples, before any automatic hook in the relevant phase; pre precedes setup, post follows verified writes, and final reporting follows post-hook completion.

Automatic announcements include the configured description alongside the normalized command ID and EXECUTE_COMMAND; optional offers retain their configured prompt and usable To execute command. Enabled/condition filtering and optional authorization rules remain unchanged.

Native apply_patch or file-edit tools are first choice for both creation and append. Under restricted temporary permissions, prohibit heredocs, here-strings, temporary-permission probes and retries of denied shell writes; direct file I/O fallback must fit existing permissions and preserve append bytes.

Action reporting must cite observed tool outcomes rather than imagined invocations or errors; final artifact verification precedes post hooks, and any hook-modified artifact is verified before reporting.
V2 constitution loading, exact per-topic allocation, Gap markers, complete append prefix and reviewer checkbox ownership remain in force.

validation_scope.offline: Package integrity, predecessor/source/discovery/example retention, routed-reference availability and tamper rejection. Checker/trace fixture tests are separate; no model instruction-compliance test is claimed.
validation_scope.fidelity_claim: Unvalidated candidate. Instruction changes and deterministic offline tests do not prove model compliance, semantic equivalence, sandbox behavior on a future host or runtime savings.
